en.title: Install JAGS and the R Packages Needed by CMSY++
en.description:
This function prepares the computer for `cmsy_run()`: it installs the missing R packages from
CRAN, downloads the JAGS installer that matches this system and R version (see
`cmsy_jags_versions()`; with `cmsy_download_jags()`, which checks its size and checksums) and
opens it, and checks the bundled CMSY++ files. It asks before installing anything when R is
used interactively.
en.details:
JAGS is a separate program, so it cannot be installed from R. On Windows and macOS the
installer is opened and you click through it; on Linux the commands to install it are shown.
Restart R after installing JAGS and run `cmsy_setup()` again to check.

The JAGS installer must match the R version (see `cmsy_jags_versions()`): on Windows JAGS
4.3.2 for R 4.5 and 4.6 and JAGS 4.3.1 for R 4.2 to 4.4; on macOS JAGS 4.3.2 for R 4.3 and
later and 4.3.1 for R 4.2; on Linux the JAGS of the package manager. JAGS 4 is used by
default because rjags on CRAN (4-17) needs JAGS 4. JAGS 5.0.0 (`jags = "latest"`) also
installs rjags 5-3 from SourceForge.
en.value:
Invisibly, the result of `cmsy_system()` after the installation. With `silent = TRUE`
no summary or download messages are printed (questions are still asked when `ask`
is TRUE).

arguments.jags:
The JAGS version to recommend: "recommended" (default; the newest JAGS 4 release
built for this R version, which works with rjags from CRAN), "latest" (JAGS 5.0.0, which
needs rjags 5-x from SourceForge) or a version number such as "4.3.2".
arguments.os:
The operating system whose settings are used: "auto" (default, detect it),
"windows", "macos" or "linux".
arguments.ask:
A logical value. If TRUE (default), ask before installing anything. In a
non-interactive session nothing is installed when `ask` is TRUE.
arguments.data_dir: The directory where downloads are kept. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If TRUE, no summary is printed. Default is FALSE, or the value
set with `fao_settings(silent = )`.

zh.title: 安装JAGS和CMSY++所需的R包
zh.description: 本函数为`cmsy_run()`做好准备：从CRAN安装缺少的R包，下载与本系统和R版本匹配的JAGS安装程序（见`cmsy_jags_versions()`；通过`cmsy_download_jags()`下载，并核对文件大小和校验值）并打开它，同时检查包内置的CMSY++文件。以交互方式使用R时，安装任何内容之前都会先询问。
zh.details:
JAGS是一个独立的程序，无法在R中安装。在Windows和macOS上会打开安装程序，按其步骤点击完成安装即可；在Linux上则显示安装命令。安装JAGS后请重启R，并再次运行`cmsy_setup()`进行检查。

JAGS安装程序必须与R版本匹配（见`cmsy_jags_versions()`）：Windows上，R 4.5和4.6用JAGS 4.3.2，R 4.2至4.4用JAGS 4.3.1；macOS上，R 4.3及以后用JAGS 4.3.2，R 4.2用4.3.1；Linux上用包管理器提供的JAGS。默认使用JAGS 4，因为CRAN上的rjags（4-17）需要JAGS 4。选择JAGS 5.0.0（`jags = "latest"`）时，还会从SourceForge安装rjags 5-3。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回安装后`cmsy_system()`的结果。`silent = TRUE`时不输出汇总信息和下载信息（`ask`为TRUE时仍会询问）。

arguments.jags: 推荐的JAGS版本："recommended"（默认；针对当前R版本编译的最新JAGS 4版本，可与CRAN上的rjags配合使用）、"latest"（JAGS 5.0.0，需要SourceForge上的rjags 5-x）或版本号，例如"4.3.2"。
arguments.os: 采用哪个操作系统的设置："auto"（默认，自动检测）、"windows"、"macos"或"linux"。
arguments.ask: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，安装任何内容之前先询问。在非交互式会话中，`ask`为TRUE时不会安装任何内容。
arguments.data_dir: 下载文件的保存目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出汇总信息。默认为FALSE，或`fao_settings(silent = )`设置的值。
